description: The pie chart presents the distribution of relation categories used in the MMRA benchmark, showing 11 slices in total, each labeled with a count and percentage. The slices are: ObservationAngle in a bright mint/teal color at 126 (12.28%); SimilarMaterial in orange at 106 (10.33%); SubEvent in pink/red at 100 (9.74%); UsageSimilarity in a muted orange/salmon at 100 (9.65%); Environment in dark teal at 90 (8.77%); Layout in pale yellow at 90 (8.77%); AppearanceSimilarity in light green at 90 (8.77%); SimilarEvent in light blue at 90 (8.77%); MentalitySimilarity in light cyan at 89 (8.67%); RelativePosition in light gray at 81 (7.90%); and NearSameEntity in dark gray at 63 (6.34%). Percentage labels are printed directly on or near the slices (along with counts), there is no separate legend, and no slice appears exploded or otherwise visually emphasized; the slice sizes appear roughly arranged from larger to smaller around the chart.
